record.tooling: Mature REST API 2.0 at api-public.filemail.com with x-api-key + x-api-version headers; real docs at docs.filemail.com. But 'only Personal, Pro, Business and Enterprise accounts have access to our API'. The free/no-account tier has NO API.
record.chaining: 5 GB x 2 transfers/day x unlimited identities. But no programmatic path on the free tier, so every unit needs a human and an account. The one genuinely interesting hook is 'Store Files Forever', which is Business/Enterprise only and consumes the account's paid storage.

limits.value: Transfer, Business/Enterprise 'unlimited file size'. And only Business/Enterprise can pick 'Forever.

record.limits_note: per-object-cap: 5 GB free / 250 GB Pro / unlimited Business. Retention: 7 days free; 'Forever' requires Business or Enterprise. request-rate: API is 20 requests per 10 seconds plus a per-plan daily leaky-bucket quota (429 on exceed). pull-count: not capped on free.
record.reliability_note: Two independent caps stack on the free tier. 5 GB AND 2 transfers/24h. And the service is geo-restricted ('the free service is not available in certain regions'). The free tier is not a storage candidate at all.
